name: repo_map / rank_files

test_list.description: Repeated calls and a reversed insertion order render the identical map.
The file whose symbols are referenced by others is first and an isolated file last.
A focus file gains rank and heads the map.
Relative to an unrelated file, a dependency of the focus file gains rank.
Focus paths that are not in the graph leave the ranking unchanged.
The rendered map never exceeds max_tokens (bytes/4 rounded up) and keeps the highest-ranked files.
An empty graph yields no entries and zero tokens.
Equal ranks are ordered by path.
Backslash and slash paths are the same file.
Adding a path twice keeps only the latest symbols.
The map version digest is stable for equal maps and differs for different ones.
Property: PageRank scores are finite, non-negative, sum to 1 and are bit-identical on repetition.
Property: the rendered map does not depend on file insertion order.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: Token budget (bytes/4 estimate) and focus files.

output_description: Files ordered by personalised PageRank with their outlines, token estimate and version digest.
